lens: Geometry and proportion first (back, headrest, cover, pillow, pan, armrest J/C, shell, legs, footrest; 0.43 m seat / 0.33 m arm as rulers), then materials, colour, lighting and artefacts. Econ code unchanged since 295e953 (wG); all numbers re-measured on r19 / s19. New real photos: ref/web/econ/b_ss_13..25, 40 (sanspotter ANA 777-300ER economy, 2023).

priorIssues.issue: wGb-1 / wGa-1 headrest cover: flat value, too light/grey head-on (middle pair), too dark close/oblique, no sheen
priorIssues.evidence: q15 head-on covers c1-c4 L50 53/68/68/54 B/R 1.69/1.54/1.54/1.69 vs y_47300 70/53/42/39 B/R 1.58/1.83/2.00/1.97 (middle pair ~20 L too light and grey). e4 mid / R #23273c L50 46/45 vs y_47306 #6a799c / #485374 L50 129/87. q16 row-2 cover L50 60 vs y_47301 78. b_ss_13 / b_ss_14 (real, cabin light) also show a slate-grey cover lighter than the fabric ground at oblique angles, with a stitched hem line ~1.5 cm above the lower edge.

priorIssues.issue: wGb-2 / wGa-3 petal fleck faint, round, too many at row distance
priorIssues.evidence: q15 s2/s4 at x0.62 vs y_47300 s2/s4: bright 0.118/0.134 vs 0.158/0.156; p90/p50 1.56/1.64 vs 1.78/1.76; hf 11.6/13.3 vs 20.1/17.8; blob median 1-2 px vs 3 px, p90 4 vs 5. Ground right (#27335d B/R 2.38 L50 56 vs #2d3b65 2.24 / 61). Close (fleck.png: e4 R vs b_ss_14 and y_47306 pad): render flecks are soft round dots; real ones are crisp angular slivers / triangles at random angles, fewer and larger.

issues.title: Headrest cover: one flat value - middle covers too light/grey head-on, all covers near-black close/oblique; no hem line
issues.evidence: q15 c2/c3 #373d55 L50 68 B/R 1.54 vs y_47300 #272d48 / #1e243c L50 53 / 42 B/R 1.83 / 2.00. e4 #23273c L50 46 vs y_47306 #6a799c / #485374 L50 129 / 87. q16 row 2 L50 60 vs 78. b_ss_13 / 14 (real): slate cover lighter than the fabric at oblique angles; stitched hem ~1.5 cm above the bottom edge.
issues.fix: SEATMAT yCover: base #262c46 (B/R ~1.85) so head-on q15 lands at L50 42-50; roughness 0.5 -> 0.35 plus a sheen / Fresnel lift (sheen colour ~#8a92ac, F90 ~0.5) so 60-75 deg views reach L50 80-110 (e4 >= 85, q16 row 2 >= 75). In 09a_econ.js add a 3 mm lighter (#4a5070) stitch line 1.5 cm above the lower cover edge, full width minus 1 cm each side.

issues.title: Petal fleck: soft round dots, too many and too faint at row distance
issues.evidence: q15 x0.62 bright 0.12-0.13 vs 0.16, p90/p50 1.56-1.64 vs 1.77, blob median 1-2 vs 3 px, hf 12-13 vs 18-20; fleck.png: real (b_ss_14, y_47306) flecks are crisp angular slivers.
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py tex_y_fleck: ~20 % fewer flecks, each ~1.5x area, polygonal (3-5 vertices, aspect 1.6-2.5:1, random angle) with hard edges (no blur before the tile resize), cores toward #c4cde6 (B/R ~1.5); keep ground #27355c. Target q15 bright ~0.155, p90/p50 ~1.75, blob median 3 px at x0.62.

issues.title: Armrest support is a diagonal J; real moulding is a C with a horizontal lower plate
issues.evidence: arm.png: y_47303 near arm (0.33 m = 160 px): arm 5.6 cm thick, open slot ~5 cm, lower plate ~6 cm tall running the full arm length at pan level, joined to the arm by a rounded nose (r ~4 cm) at the front; b_ss_18 the same. Render jp Bezier runs from (y 0.625, z -0.085) to (0.512, -0.375): a diagonal, leaving a triangular window.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js econUnit: replace the jp Bezier with a C path: arm underside at the nose (y 0.61, z -0.39) -> arc r 0.045 down to (y 0.50, z -0.40) -> straight aft at y 0.49-0.50 to z -0.10 -> rise to the rear pivot (y 0.60, z -0.08). Section ~2.5 cm wide x 6 cm tall on the horizontal run (scale the tube x 0.45 as now, y 1.1). Keeps the tri count.

issues.title: Tick weave reads as long rain streaks at row distance
issues.fix: tex_y_tick: break the pale strokes into 1-1.5 cm dashes with ~40 % navy gaps, straight columns, dark channels -15 % L; target q15 p10/p50 ~0.52, bright ~0.08.

issues.title: White hood side band 1.5-1.7 cm head-on (photo ~1.1 cm)
issues.evidence: q15 L>170 runs 7-8 px at y 290-350 at ~205 px/back vs y_47300 3-4 px at 122 px.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: hood side wrap 0.5 cm narrower per side (or the fabric back 0.5 cm wider at hood height).

issues.title: Seat-back pocket: flat black mesh strip instead of a padded flap over a bulging mesh
issues.evidence: e6 vs b_ss_23 / b_ss_21: real pocket = light-grey padded leatherette flap (~8 cm, rounded top) over a ~7 cm mesh with a 2.5 cm dark-grey elastic band, bulging ~2 cm.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: mesh band 3 -> 7 cm tall, bowed 2 cm aft at mid-height, dark-grey #3a3c42 elastic top band 2.5 cm; flap above it as a 0.8 cm-thick rounded box #c9cbcf.

issues.title: Diamond ground greyish, stars soft (carried)
issues.fix: Diamond tile B/R +0.3, star edge contrast +25 %.

issues.title: Side-panel fabric smear (triplanar); pillow face plain
issues.evidence: q18 left back side, e3 side streaks; e4b pillow no seam.
issues.fix: Triplanar blend power ~8 on seat fabrics; pillow 4 mm piped seam.

issues.title: q16 near fabric too light and grey (not scored)
issues.fix: About -1 stop of fill on the near aisle seats in q16 and less grey ambient.

issues.title: Camera mismatches (not scored)
issues.evidence: q15 lower and closer than y_47300 (205 vs 122 px backs); q16 looks across the cabin, y_47301 down the left aisle; q17 is a high rear view vs y_47303 window-side profile.
issues.fix: Match the cameras to the photos; b_ss_13 is a useful extra real-photo pair for q16.

questionsForUser: Headrest cover: real photos (sanspotter b_ss_13, y_47306) show it hanging below the pad as rendered; y_47300 appears to have raised headrests. OK to treat y_47306 as the default?
